subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Daniel's grandfather gave him an old camera.”?
options: Daniel still used his phone often, but the old camera taught him a different way to look.
When old infrastructure loses its first purpose, it may still guide people through history in a new way.
Things that look alike still need a way to be told apart.
Her mother said, "It cannot do its old job, but it can still do a new one."

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Daniel still used his phone often, but the old camera taught him a different way to look.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「When old infrastructure loses its first purpose, it may still guide people through history in a new way.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Things that look alike still need a way to be told apart.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Her mother said, 'It cannot do its old job, but it can still do a new one.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Daniel still used his phone often, but the old camera taught him a different way to look.」，答案為「Daniel still used his phone often, but the old camera taught him a different way to look.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Daniel still used his phone often, but the old camera taught him a different way to look.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
